code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    div_col = next((c for c in range(1, w-1) if len(set(row[c] for row in grid)) == 1), None)
    if div_col is not None:
        left = [row[:div_col] for row in grid]
        right = [row[div_col+1:] for row in grid]
        shared = set(x for row in left for x in row) & set(x for row in right for x in row)
        color = next(iter(shared))
        return [[3 if left[r][c] == color and right[r][c] == color else color
                 for c in range(div_col)] for r in range(h)]
    div_row = next((r for r in range(1, h-1) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)
    top = grid[:div_row]
    bottom = grid[div_row+1:]
    shared = set(x for row in top for x in row) & set(x for row in bottom for x in row)
    color = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if top[r][c] == color and bottom[r][c] == color else color
             for c in range(len(top[0]))] for r in range(len(top))]
'''
